relations.rationale: Carrying a box sets up the natural next action of setting it down beside the table.
Finn's carrying a box is unrelated to Bo's relative age.
Finn carrying rolling stock has no bearing on Nell unpacking signal boxes.
Finn carrying a box is unrelated to Nell's competition ranking.
Setting a box beside the table has nothing to do with Bo helping Zeno with lighting.
Bo's age relative to Finn is unrelated to Nell's height relative to Bo and Hugo.
Bo being a year older than Finn has no bearing on Nell's unpacking activity.
Age difference doesn't imply or preclude being in the same class.
Bo's age relative to Finn has no connection to layout placement near the door.
Bo's age is unrelated to Finn's placement in the competition.
Bo's age relative to Finn doesn't determine Finn's class relationship with Nell.
Bo's age difference from Finn is unrelated to Bo helping Zeno with lighting.
Bo's age relative to Finn has no bearing on Nell's suggestions about track spacing.
Bo wheeling in a suitcase is unrelated to when Nell arrived.
Bo's arrival with scenery pieces doesn't indicate anything about the two latecomers expected at noon.
Bo carrying a suitcase of scenery pieces is unrelated to which layout is largest or closest to the door.
Bo's suitcase contents have no bearing on whether Hugo is the event organizer.
Nell's height relative to Bo and Hugo is unrelated to which class Finn and Bo share.
Nell being tallest is unrelated to members comparing locomotives.
Nell's height compared to Bo and Hugo has no bearing on Hugo's role as organizer.
